notRescored.reason: HISTORICAL_NONBLIND_EVIDENCE: Luna's run was not blind (expected-label knowledge was not withheld the way the Qwen/Haiku MINIMAL cohort was isolated), so rescoring it under R2 would not add independent cross-model evidence. Its artifacts remain immutable and are not used to support the R2 conclusion.

These experiments' own conclusions are not about the F1/DOCUMENT_LABEL question this correction touches (the masthead family's F1 is one supporting case among several in a broader research thread about organisation-masthead metadata, not itself the finding). They keep pinning the R1 vintage explicitly so their raw results and historical interpretation stay reproducible and are not silently restated as if R2 had been in effect when they ran. Revisiting their own conclusions in light of R2 is separate work this correction does not do.
